Welcome to The Finology Podcast!
We bring you unfiltered, high-value conversations with leading market experts, top fund managers, and visionary CEOs to help you make smarter financial decisions.
In this episode, we are joined by Radhika Gupta (CEO, Edelweiss Mutual Fund) for a masterclass on scaling asset managers, navigating digital disruption, and the future of wealth distribution in India.
